title: TrustSignalRecord
description: Detailed evidence record for a trust state classification. The authoritative source for trust decisions. ToolRecord.trust_state is a denormalized copy of derived_trust_state here.

subject_id.description: ID of the ToolRecord, SkillRecord, or EcosystemRecord being evaluated.

observed_signals.description: All signals observed. Each signal has a tier, type, and evidence description.

tier.description: 1=production evidence. 2=quality indicators. 3=surface metrics. Tier 3 signals alone cannot establish production-grade trust.

description.description: What was observed. Be specific — avoid 'high production adoption' without evidence.

verifiable.description: Whether this signal can be independently verified by checking the source.

derived_trust_state.description: Trust state derived from the balance of observed signals. Must be justified by Tier 1 signals for production-grade classification.

trust_reasoning.description: Narrative explanation of how the observed signals lead to the derived trust state. Required for non-obvious classifications.

anti_patterns_observed.description: Trust anti-patterns detected. e.g. 'High GitHub stars with low issue activity — star inflation suspected.'

reviewed_at.description: When this trust evaluation was performed. Trust states decay — web3 tooling moves fast.

reviewed_by.description: Who or what performed this evaluation.

next_review_at.description: Scheduled next review. Emerging tools should be reviewed every 60 days. Production-grade tools every 180 days.
